summary: Loch Duart, a UK salmon producer, has become the first in the country to adopt BioMar's Blue Impact feed product. The adoption represents a market milestone for BioMar's sustainable aquaculture feed offering.
title: Loch Duart becomes first salmon producer in UK to choose BioMar’s “Blue Impact” feed

summary: BioMar is expanding its Aquaculture Technology Centre in Hirtshals, Denmark, signaling investment in research and development capabilities. title: BioMar expanding Aquaculture Technology Centre in Hirtshals, Denmark
